findings.title: Make explicit option overrides preserve complete advertised IDs
findings.impact: Valid advertised settings cannot be selected or overridden through the new native launch dialog; option IDs containing '=' also cannot be represented by the new CLI --option parser. For the frozen delimiter-containing profile, a deliberate native override to full is rejected locally instead of launching with that supported choice. The CLI splits the same ID incorrectly and passes a different option ID to daemon/settings resolution.
findings.evidence: src/tui/launch.rs:106-110 splits the field on ',' and then split_once('='), while src/acp/settings.rs:22-34 accepts complete non-control option IDs/values up to 256 bytes. The frozen public peer at tests/fixtures/acp_peer.rs:382-386 actually advertises option ID 'fixture,detail=level' with choices 'brief,exact=value' and 'full'. Entering 'fixture,detail=level=full' yields a first native segment 'fixture' with no '=', so Dialog::request returns an error before NativeControl::launch. src/cli.rs uses the first-equals split for --option, producing ID 'fixture,detail' rather than the advertised ID; daemon profile merging and Configuration::resolve then receive the wrong identity. tests/acp/native/daily_use.rs tests this catalog only with Options untouched. git show confirmed src/tui/launch.rs is absent from the specified base, establishing introduced provenance.
findings.fix: Provide a bounded lossless representation for explicit option ID/value pairs in the native editor and CLI, such as structured pairs or a documented escaping scheme; preserve IDs and values unchanged through daemon settings resolution. Keep structured default inheritance intact and add native/CLI regressions that explicitly override delimiter-containing IDs and choices, rather than only inheriting them.

summary: Independent static review covered all 32 frozen files, the three E06 stories, permitted PLAN lines and narrow unchanged consumers. One introduced P2 correctness issue remains in lossless explicit setting overrides, so the source gate is FAIL despite 30/32 checklist items passing (93.75%). No additional supported defect was established in ownership/input races, original ACP responder identity, settings acknowledgment, same-target recovery or geometry fencing; this is not live/runtime acceptance.
limits: Read-only source review, with two scoped read-only scouts assisting full-file coverage. No edits, builds, tests, lint, formatting, source/shell execution, provider calls, auth/config/daemon/global operations or commits were performed. Git diff/show were used only for permitted patch/provenance inspection. Prior review/audit/repair/runtime reports, saved handoffs, execution logs, real auth and private retired fixtures were not read. Manifest content hashes were not recomputed. Test bodies, synthetic fixtures, ignored live cases, documentation claims and plan approval provide no exercised runtime proof; installed OMP same-instance question/allow/deny, actual CLI/native behavior, cleanup and historical unknown native settlement remain separate parent runtime gates.
